name: shared-delegation-verifier
usage: verifyNormal or verifyCheckpoint only checks local JWT signature and immutable claims; it is not authorization.
Verify the separate actor service token for the receiving audience and required permission.
For normal use pass authoritative ACTIVE Session and CurrentProof to authorize. For checkpoint use authorizeCheckpoint and enforce CheckpointCommitGuard transaction semantics.
CurrentProof is populated exclusively from authenticated current grant and domain authority checks, never from caller input.
